description: This source file contains utility functions for voice wake triggers sanitization and locale identifier normalization used in the VoiceWakeHelpers module within the OpenClaw app.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of voice wake trigger words by trimming whitespace, limiting their length, and ensuring minimum triggers with default fallback.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Normalizes locale identifier strings by removing specific suffixes and substrings related to Unicode extensions and variations.
